t: How to Set Up Thrive Apprentice Email Templates
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to customize the email templates that Thrive Apprentice sends to your students—including welcome emails, course access notifications, and more—so every message matches your brand and delivers the right information.

What Are Email Templates?

Thrive Apprentice automatically sends emails to students at key moments—such as when they enroll in a course, receive access to new content, or complete a course. Email templates let you control the content, design, and personalization of these automated messages.

Accessing Email Templates

  1. Go to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click Settings in the left sidebar.
  3. Select Email Templates from the settings menu.

Important: Before you can customize templates, you must configure an email delivery service provider. If you haven't done this yet, Thrive Apprentice will prompt you to select one when you first open the Email Templates settings.

Available Email Templates

Thrive Apprentice includes templates for the most common student communications:

  • Welcome Email — Sent when a student first registers or gains access to your platform.
  • Course Access Email — Sent when a student is granted access to a specific course.
  • Course Completion Email — Sent when a student finishes all lessons in a course.
  • Certificate Email — Sent when a student earns a certificate upon course completion.

Note: The exact templates available may vary depending on your Thrive Apprentice configuration and connected integrations.

Customizing an Email Template

  1. On the Email Templates screen, click the template you want to edit.
  2. Modify the Subject Line to reflect your branding or messaging.
  3. Edit the Email Body using the built-in editor. You can adjust text, formatting, and layout.
  4. Insert Dynamic Tags (also called merge fields) to personalize each email automatically.
  5. Click Save when you're finished.

Using Dynamic Tags for Personalization

Dynamic tags let you insert student-specific or course-specific information into your emails. Common tags include:

  • Student Name — Inserts the student's first name or full name.
  • Course Name — Inserts the name of the relevant course.
  • Course URL — Adds a direct link to the course.
  • Site Name — Inserts your website's name.

To insert a dynamic tag, place your cursor in the email body where you want the tag to appear and select the tag from the available options in the editor toolbar.

Testing Your Emails

Always test your emails before they go live to make sure everything looks correct.

  1. After editing a template, click the Send Test Email button.
  2. Enter an email address where you'd like to receive the test.
  3. Check your inbox for the test email and review the content, formatting, and dynamic tag output.
  4. Make any necessary adjustments and save again.

Tip: Send test emails to multiple email clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail) to verify that your formatting renders correctly across platforms.

That's it! You've successfully configured and customized your Thrive Apprentice email templates, ensuring your students receive polished, personalized communications at every stage of their learning journey.

t: How to Add a Progress Bar to Your Thrive Apprentice Lessons
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to add a progress bar to your Thrive Apprentice lesson templates—giving students a clear visual indicator of how far they've advanced through your course.

What Does the Progress Bar Show?

The progress bar displays a student's completion percentage for the current course. As learners finish each lesson, the bar fills up accordingly, providing instant visual feedback on their overall advancement. This keeps students motivated and helps them understand how much content remains.

Adding the Progress Bar to a Lesson Template

The progress bar is added through Thrive Architect, the visual editor used to design your lesson layouts. You can add it to individual lessons or—more efficiently—to your lesson template so it appears on every lesson automatically.

Adding to a Lesson Template (Recommended)

  1. Go to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click Design in the left sidebar to access your course templates.
  3. Select the lesson template you want to edit and click Edit with Thrive Architect.
  4. In the Thrive Architect editor, click the Add Element button (the plus icon) in the right sidebar.
  5. Search for Progress Bar in the element list.
  6. Drag the Progress Bar element to your desired location within the lesson layout.
  7. Click Save Work when you're finished, then click Done to return to Thrive Apprentice.

Tip: Placing the progress bar near the top of your lesson template—above or below the lesson title—ensures students see it immediately when they open any lesson.

Adding to an Individual Lesson

  1. Go to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Navigate to the course and open the lesson you want to edit.
  3. Click Edit Content to open the lesson in Thrive Architect.
  4. Click the Add Element button and search for Progress Bar.
  5. Drag it into your lesson content area.
  6. Click Save Work, then click Done.

Customization Options

Once you've placed the progress bar, click on it to reveal its customization options in the left sidebar panel. You can adjust:

  • Bar Color — Change the fill color to match your brand or course theme.
  • Background Color — Set the color of the unfilled portion of the bar.
  • Height and Width — Adjust the bar's dimensions to fit your layout.
  • Border Radius — Round the corners for a softer appearance.
  • Label Display — Show or hide the percentage label on the bar.
  • Typography — Customize the font, size, and color of the percentage text.

Note: The progress bar automatically calculates completion based on the number of lessons a student has marked as complete within the course. You don't need to configure the calculation logic—it works out of the box.

Where the Progress Bar Appears

If you add the progress bar to your lesson template, it will appear on every lesson that uses that template. If you add it to an individual lesson's content, it will only appear on that specific lesson. For a consistent student experience, the template approach is recommended.

That's it! You've successfully added a progress bar to your Thrive Apprentice lessons, helping students track their journey through your course at a glance.

t: How to Attach Downloadable Files to Lessons in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to attach downloadable files—such as PDFs, worksheets, checklists, and other resources—to your Thrive Apprentice lessons so students can access supplementary materials directly from the lesson page.

Why Attach Downloadable Files?

Downloadable resources enhance the learning experience by providing students with materials they can reference offline. Common examples include:

  • PDF guides and workbooks
  • Worksheets and checklists
  • Slide decks and presentations
  • Code files or templates
  • Certificates of completion

Attaching Files Using the Resources Feature

Thrive Apprentice provides a built-in resources feature that lets you attach files directly to any lesson.

  1. Go to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click Courses in the left sidebar and open the course containing your lesson.
  3. Click on the lesson where you want to attach a file.
  4. In the lesson settings panel, locate the Resources section.
  5. Click the Add Resources button.
  6. Choose Upload File to select a file from your computer, or Media Library to choose a file you've already uploaded.
  7. Once the file is uploaded, give it a descriptive label (e.g., "Module 1 Worksheet" or "Lesson Checklist").
  8. Click Save to attach the file to the lesson.

Tip: Use clear, descriptive file names and labels so students immediately understand what each download contains.

Adding Download Links Within Lesson Content

You can also embed download links directly inside your lesson content for more contextual placement.

  1. Open the lesson and click Edit Content to launch Thrive Architect.
  2. Add a Text element or Button element where you want the download link.
  3. Highlight the text or configure the button, then click the Link icon.
  4. Upload or select your file from the Media Library and insert its URL.
  5. Click Save Work, then click Done.

This approach works well when you want to offer a download at a specific point in the lesson—for example, a diploma or certificate link at the end of a final lesson.

Where Students See the Downloads

Files attached via the Resources section appear in a dedicated resources area on the lesson page. The exact placement depends on your lesson template, but typically resources display below or beside the main lesson content. Students can click the file name or a download icon to save the file to their device.

Note: Only students who have access to the lesson can see and download attached files. If a lesson is restricted, the resources remain hidden from unauthorized visitors.

Managing Attached Files

You can update or remove attached files at any time.

  • To replace a file: Remove the existing file from the Resources section and upload the updated version.
  • To delete a file: Click the Remove icon next to the file in the Resources section, then click Save.
  • To reorder files: Drag and drop the files within the Resources section to change their display order.

Important: If you delete a file from your WordPress Media Library, it will also be removed from any lessons where it was attached. Make sure you no longer need a file before deleting it from the library.

That's it! You've successfully attached downloadable files to your Thrive Apprentice lessons, giving students easy access to supplementary materials that support their learning.

t: How to Enable Course-Level Grading in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to enable and configure course-level grading in Thrive Apprentice—so you can assign overall grades to students based on their performance across multiple assessments within a course.

What Is Course-Level Grading?

Course-level grading calculates a single final grade for each student by combining their scores from all assessments in a course. Instead of viewing each quiz or assessment result in isolation, students receive an overall course grade that reflects their total performance. This is especially useful for courses that include multiple graded activities like quizzes, assignments, or final exams.

Enabling Course-Level Grading

  1. Go to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click Courses in the left sidebar and open the course you want to grade.
  3. In the course settings, locate the Grading section.
  4. Toggle the Enable Overall Grade switch to the on position.
  5. Click Save to apply the change.

Note: You must have at least one assessment (e.g., a quiz) added to your course before enabling grading. If no assessments exist, the grading option may not appear.

Configuring Grading Options

Once grading is enabled, you can fine-tune how the overall grade is calculated.

Assessment Weighting

By default, all assessments contribute equally to the final grade. If certain assessments should count more than others, you can configure individual weights.

  1. In the Grading section, click Set Assessment Weighting.
  2. Assign a weight percentage to each assessment (e.g., midterm quiz at 30%, final exam at 70%).
  3. Ensure the total weight adds up to 100%.
  4. Click Save to confirm your settings.

Tip: Use higher weights for comprehensive assessments like final exams, and lower weights for shorter quizzes or checkpoint activities.

Grade Display Settings

You can control how grades are presented to students.

  • Percentage — Display the grade as a percentage (e.g., 85%).
  • Letter Grade — Display the grade as a letter (e.g., A, B, C) based on thresholds you define.
  • Pass/Fail — Display a simple pass or fail result based on a minimum score threshold.

How Grades Are Calculated

Thrive Apprentice considers all completed assessments within the course and calculates the overall grade automatically. If you've configured assessment weighting, each score is multiplied by its assigned weight before being combined. If no custom weights are set, all assessments are averaged equally.

Important: Only completed assessments are factored into the grade. If a student has not yet attempted an assessment, it will not count toward their overall grade until they submit it.

Where Students See Their Grades

Students can view their overall course grade in the following locations:

  • Course Completion Page — The final grade is displayed on the course completion page after the student finishes all required content.
  • Student Dashboard — If you've configured a student dashboard, grades appear alongside course progress information.
  • Certificates — You can issue certificates that include the student's grade automatically. Enable this under the Certificates settings for the course.

Tip: Combine grading with certificates to reward students who meet a minimum grade threshold—for example, issuing a certificate only to students who score 80% or higher.

That's it! You've successfully enabled course-level grading in Thrive Apprentice, giving your students clear feedback on their overall performance and adding a professional layer to your online courses.

t: How to Use the Thrive Apprentice Widget Area
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to use the Thrive Apprentice widget area to add extra features, helpful information, and supplementary content to your course pages—enhancing the student experience without editing individual lessons.

What Is the Widget Area?

The Thrive Apprentice widget area is a designated section on your course pages where you can place WordPress widgets. Widgets are small content blocks that display information or functionality—such as a sidebar with course navigation, a call-to-action banner, or a list of recent lessons. The widget area lets you control what appears alongside your main course content.

Where Does the Widget Area Appear?

Depending on your course layout and theme, the Thrive Apprentice widget area typically appears in the sidebar or below the main content on course-related pages. This includes:

  • The main Courses listing page
  • Individual Course Overview pages
  • Lesson pages
  • Module and Chapter pages

Note: The exact position of the widget area depends on your active WordPress theme and any customizations you've made through Thrive Theme Builder. Some themes place widgets in a right sidebar, while others use a footer or below-content area.

Adding Widgets to the Thrive Apprentice Widget Area

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Appearance > Widgets.
  2. Locate the Thrive Apprentice widget area in the list of available widget areas. It may be labeled as Thrive Apprentice Sidebar or similar, depending on your theme.
  3. Click the widget area to expand it.
  4. Click the Add Widget button (or use the block inserter if you're using the block-based widget editor).
  5. Select the widget you want to add from the available options.
  6. Configure the widget settings as needed (e.g., title, content, display options).
  7. Click Save or Update to apply your changes.

Tip: You can drag and drop widgets within the area to reorder them. The order in the widget editor matches the order they appear on the front end.

Common Widgets to Use

Here are some popular widgets that work well in the Thrive Apprentice widget area:

  • Text/HTML Widget — Add custom text, announcements, or HTML content. Great for course-specific messages or instructor bios.
  • Navigation Menu Widget — Display a secondary menu with links to related courses, resources, or external materials.
  • Search Widget — Let students search through course content directly from the sidebar.
  • Recent Lessons Widget — Show a list of recently published or updated lessons to keep students informed of new content.
  • Custom HTML Widget — Embed calls-to-action, promotional banners, or third-party tools using custom HTML code.
  • Image Widget — Add visual elements such as a course badge, instructor photo, or branding graphic.

Managing and Removing Widgets

You can update or remove widgets at any time.

  • To edit a widget: Go to Appearance > Widgets, expand the Thrive Apprentice widget area, click the widget, and modify its settings.
  • To remove a widget: Click the widget to expand it, then click the Remove or Delete option. The widget will be removed from the course pages immediately.
  • To temporarily disable a widget: Drag it to the Inactive Widgets area instead of deleting it—this preserves your settings for later use.

Important: Changes to widgets take effect on all course pages that display the widget area. If you need different widgets on different pages, consider using a widget visibility plugin to control which widgets appear where.

That's it! You've successfully configured the Thrive Apprentice widget area, adding useful sidebar content and functionality to create a more engaging course experience for your students.
